topic: Yuji's Shibuya loss was the setup: eleven fingers at once while he was unconscious
title: Yuji's Shibuya Loss Was Sukuna's Setup
description: Yuji Itadori's loss in the Shibuya Incident is usually called just a defeat. My read is that the unconscious body and eleven fingers at once made it the setup for Sukuna's takeover.
comment: Was Shibuya a setup Sukuna needed, or just a bad night that Yuji paid for?

lines.text: Yuji Itadori didn't lose because Sukuna was stronger.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori close-up, dark Shibuya night

lines.text: He lost because he was unconscious when the fingers went in.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori unconscious on the ground

lines.text: Here's the moment Shibuya turned on one bad night.

shot.fallback: anime style, Shibuya street at night

lines.text: Yuji went down to Choso, and Mimiko and Nanako found him.

shot.fallback: anime style, Choso fighting Yuji Itadori

lines.text: They forced eleven of Sukuna's fingers into him at once.

shot.search: Nanako Hasaba feeds Yuji Itadori finger
shot.fallback: anime style, a girl feeding a finger to a boy

lines.text: Eleven was more than his will could hold back.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori struggling inside

lines.text: Sukuna took over, and Yuji's own body became Sukuna's.

shot.search: Sukuna takes over Yuji Itadori body
shot.fallback: anime style, Sukuna's eyes replacing Yuji's

lines.text: That's the part fans skip when they call Shibuya just a defeat.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori on the ground

lines.text: Yuji's will held through the first finger.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori holding firm

lines.text: It didn't hold through the whole pile.

shot.fallback: anime style, a pile of cursed fingers

lines.text: So the loss was the door, and the feeding opened it.

shot.fallback: anime style, a door opening in the dark

lines.text: Here's my read: Sukuna needed Yuji down, and he got him down.
That's why Shibuya is a setup, not a clean win for Sukuna.

shot.fallback: anime style, Sukuna over a dark city

lines.text: Yuji had to lose first, because Sukuna couldn't win without that loss.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori and Sukuna in one frame

self_check.loop: The last line leads back into line 1: Yuji did not lose to strength.
